legend.verdicts: coherent = engine does what the text says; partial = part true, part not; notImplemented = claimed mechanic absent; contradicts = engine does something else; flavor = joke/ambience with no factual claim; obsolete = text never shown/played (claimHolds tells whether its claim would be true)

mechanicsNeeded: Per-segment infrastructure for every corridor, loaded from segments.json (km, gauge ib/std/mixto, electrification none/3kV/25kV, vmax, single/double/mixed track, condition %, loading-gauge class, terrain tags ramp/mountain/trench/tunnel/hot). Corridor punctuality, speed and costs derive from its segments. Works target one segment (e.g. «renovar Ávila–Medina, 86 km»). Fixes t-3, s1 obstacle 2, ev-cable, ev-nevada, ev-desprendimiento, ev-tuneles, Extremadura electrification and the map layers.

Real corridor lengths for every km-based cost (Norte 421, Levante 487, Sur 571 km instead of 345/390/470). The map layers come from the same segments, not from the LAV paths that baseSegments picks today (pal–leo, cor–sev, leo–pol).

Train profiles from trains.json (traction diesel/electric/bimodo, voltages[], gauge ib/std/variable, vmax, seats, gálibo, reliability, A/C reliability, age/condition). Assigning a train to a corridor validates every segment: gauge, voltage or diesel, gálibo. Energy cost follows the train's traction, not a corridor boolean.

Trenespop inside the unified game: new orders with an exact delivery week (shown and honoured: «Llega sem. N»), used listings with condition, per-corridor compatibility. The maker's 7 % commission is an explicit offer spoken by that maker's rep (cor-comision), bound to that contract and recorded in the secrets ledger.

One visible breakdown system: probability from reliability × condition × segment stress (ramps, heat), located on a train and a segment. Repair options state the exact operated weeks lost (overtime = 1, workshop = 3), counted in operated weeks. Tech/megaproject breakdown modifiers apply to it. The week-2 tutorial breakdown is La Abuela (Serie 592) on mad–avi.

Located incidents with durations: copper theft on a 3 kV segment (speed limit), snow on mountain segments in winter weeks, rockfall on a trench segment (closure from the moment it is announced), heat on hot corridors, A/C failure of a named train. Choice notes show the REALISED punctuality change computed with punctProjection, not the target delta.

A weekly report shown after every close: silent breakdowns, failed tests, works stopped for lack of cash or crews, OSP amount and minor breaches, aid paid, arrivals, strikes. The «Semana N · ±X» toast alone is not enough.

Payroll multiplier = 1 + pact upkeep + strike deals (payrollExtra), charged in weeklyAccounts. A strike is an interval {from: next operated week, weeks: N} with tickets ×0,4. The convenio breach and «Aguantar» both use it. The sindicato bribe also blocks new strikes for 13 weeks.

Character roster by date and state: Raquel minister up to week 208, Óscar from week 209; a dismissed Benito is replaced by a new Adif boss. Generic lines (stage-pass, pact-done, fin-retirada, end-win, negotiate-ok/no) resolve their speaker by role and date, or by pact counterpart. The player is addressed as «presidente de Tenfe».

Grudges and trust per character with real effects: minister (−0,5 M€ next OSP, no visits or inauguration offers for 26 weeks), adif/Benito (+1 week of permits), mayor (−5 territorios target and extortion), workshop (strike risk), riders (viajeros −).

Secrets ledger: each secret has a type, amount, contract/corridor, participants and witnesses. Extortion is possible only for a witness of that secret, with a line naming it. Leaks and scandals use the secret's own line and text (sc-comision with the maker, sc-pacto-meseta, sc-accidente, sc-sobres listing the actual recipients). A secret cannot be exposed twice.

One judicial-stage function: every stage change, including the jumps caused by the judge or Charo, emits its notice (jud-1/2/3) and its support hits. A failed judge bribe either ends the game («es el final») or the text is changed. Archiving the case has its own line.

Pacts: the shown terms equal the applied terms (the cheaper version has its own benefit text). A baseline is stored at signing, so a condition must be achieved after signing (cohesion). Rule checks treat same-week actions the same way (≥). Rejecting has a per-counterpart cost. «Antes de las elecciones» caps the deadline at week 207. The corrupt pact adds secret «pacto-meseta».

Contrato-programa breach: repayment with interest and a certain Treasury audit 2 weeks later. The audit inspects the secrets ledger and exposes secrets whose evidence ≥ threshold, raising the judicial stage.

Stage objectives evaluated exactly as worded: s2 tracks the minimum cash over weeks 14-52; s3 needs accounts + programme items + the week-208 election; s4 Lowgo share is pax-weighted over operated corridors only; s5 grants the «placa». Failing s1 has the consequence t-1 promises (Treasury supervision: 2 orders/week in s2).

Lowgo as a real operator: fare 9 €, seat capacity, paths only on LAV/standard-gauge relations parallel to the player's corridors (Madrid–València, Madrid–Sevilla, València–Barcelona), demand split by fare and time, its own spokesperson. Autocares Meseta (Íñigo) stays a separate coach rival with the feeder pact.

Corridor-specific events require their subject to exist: viral needs Teruel open with a staffed train; the visit needs the Norte open and runs on a real train; tunnels need a BCBB ordered or assigned for Cantabria; snow on «Pajares» needs Asturias open.
Loading gauge (gálibo): pal–san (Cantabria) reduced; BCBB units wide. Assignment is refused, and a tunnel-clearance work exists as an alternative.

Exact bribe effects: permits measured in days (−50 % works on 1-week preps); inspector risk bound to the works certified under the bribe, decaying over 26 weeks, with the accident on that segment; the alcalde envelope recorded with Paco as witness.

Works deliver what their text says: electrification sets 3 kV or 25 kV per segment and makes EMUs assignable; electric traction lowers breakdowns; the CTC «incident» modifier is read; Borja's crew builds ×1,33 slower (instead of −3 track); certifying phantom sleepers raises the work cost.
The Paco station is a node work that does not occupy the corridor work slot, or the pact discloses the slot block and the −9 phased penalty.
Crews bound to works: a work pauses when its crews leave (loan or subcontract expiry). Event crew dispatch requires a free crew. Random events never crash when no target exists.
Insolvency choices are disabled when they would do nothing and show the cash each one recovers. Rescues count over the whole mandate (or the texts say «dos últimos años»).

Tech modifiers with the right sign and the full stated effect: App −15 % staff costs; bimodo becomes a train type; prensa halves scandal AND breakdown support losses, which requires breakdowns to cost support.
Milestone unlocks that exist: tier-4 technologies, or remove «Nivel 4»; a cosmetic «Placa conmemorativa» at Atocha; «Abrir corredores nuevos» listed at m1.

Headlines conditioned on their subject: Norte headlines only when the Norte is late or punctual; «récord» headlines only on tracked records; «por primera vez» only once; bus-replacement headlines only while a bus-mode work is active; «semana tranquila» only when the report is empty. The unused corruption headlines are used or dropped.
Tutorial map highlight of the named corridor (Norte stroke pulsing) instead of the whole canvas.
Recurring obligations: fleet insurance every 52 weeks, scaled with fleet size.
Daily frequency for «tren diario» from timetable data (at least 1 round trip per day), not just trains > 0.
The Benito extortion as a recurring payroll cost («subir el sueldo»), selected by witness rather than secrets-array order.

entries.text: Bienvenido a Tenfe. Te lo resumo: no hay dinero, no hay trenes y el Norte llega tarde hasta a su propio funeral. Tienes ocho años. Las primeras trece semanas deciden si llegas a la segunda.
entries.claim: No money, no trains, the Norte is late; the mandate lasts eight years; the first 13 weeks decide whether you reach the second (stage/quarter).
entries.trigger: Tutorial step 0 (UI:57), shown by coach() and spoken once (UI:447-461) when s.week===1 && !s.tutorial.done (UI:68).
entries.choiceEffects: No choice ("Vamos"). Initial state: cash 12 M€, debt 18 M€, Q1 payments 2,5 (wk5) + 0,4 (wk9) + 2,0 (wk13) M€ (R:41-45); 4 trains for 3 corridors (R:63-65); ordinary result −0,093 M€/week (sim a1).
entries.why: "Tienes ocho años" holds (WEEKS=416, D:7). "No hay dinero / no hay trenes" is hyperbole (12 M€ in cash). "Las primeras trece semanas deciden si llegas a la segunda" is false: failing s1 only adds 1 grave breach (R:1120) and the game ends only at 3 (R:1121, R:1250); the player always reaches stage 2.
entries.unifiedFix: Recorded line: keep the text and make it true. Failing the first objective puts Tenfe under Treasury supervision for the next stage (2 orders/week instead of 3, and no new loans) on top of the grave breach. Show that consequence on the mission panel from week 1. Alternatively re-record (~50 s) as «…si fallas, empiezas el segundo trimestre intervenido».

entries.text: Soy Marisa, de la asociación de viajeros. Pincha en el corredor Norte del mapa. Ese que parpadea en rojo. Así llevamos meses.
entries.claim: The Norte corridor on the map is the one blinking in red; it has been like that for months.
entries.trigger: Tutorial step 1 (UI:58), focus ".rs-map"; done when ui.selected==="norte".
entries.choiceEffects: None.
entries.why: Red holds: punctColor(62)="#c23b2f" (MAP:60, 86) while Levante 71 and Sur 68 are orange. The blink does not: .rs-focus (rescate.css:248, rs-pulse) is applied to the whole canvas (UI:58, 459-460); the Norte stroke itself does not blink.
entries.unifiedFix: UI only, so the recorded line stays. While tutorial step 1 is active, the map pulses the stroke of the named corridor or segment (drawSelected with a sin(t) alpha on "norte") instead of outlining the canvas.

entries.text: Benito, de obras. El problema es la vía entre Ávila y Medina. Pulsa «Renovar la vía»: siete semanas y una cuadrilla. Elige cómo mantienes el servicio mientras tanto.
entries.claim: The problem is the track between Ávila and Medina; "Renovar la vía" takes seven weeks and one crew; you choose how to keep service during the works.
entries.trigger: Tutorial step 2 (UI:59), focus the Renovar button.
entries.choiceEffects: Quote for renovar on the Norte (R:296-330; D:95, 108-110): «autobuses» (default, UI:202) phases [1,5,1] = 7 weeks, 1 crew, 2,35 M€ (=max(0,9; 345×0,0068)), service week 8, punctuality 85,06 % at week 13. «por fases» = 10 weeks (79,63 % at week 13, which fails s1). «cortar vía» = 6 weeks (85,58 %) (sim a1).
entries.why: "Siete semanas y una cuadrilla" holds for the default mode. "Entre Ávila y Medina" is not modelled. The corridor has a single track value (44 %). Renovar adds +46 to it (R:1313) and is priced on the whole corridor at 345 km (real Norte: 421 km). In reality Ávila–Medina is one 86 km segment: Iberian gauge, 3 kV, 150 km/h, double track (segments.json).
entries.unifiedFix: Model track condition per segment. The Norte starts with avi–med (86 km) at about 25 % and the other segments at 55-65 %. Punctuality and speed come from the segments, so the worst segment caps the corridor. «Renovar la vía» on avi–med keeps phases [1,5,1] in bus mode, so «siete semanas» stays true. Price per segment km with a minimum, and rebalance the s1 money.

entries.text: Charo, de Presupuestos. Antes de firmar, mira la cuenta: lo que cuesta ahora, lo que cuesta cada semana y lo que tienes que pagar pronto. La ayuda europea es financiación prevista: no la cobras hasta certificar la obra.
entries.claim: Before signing, look at the cost now, the cost per week and what you must pay soon; EU aid is planned funding, paid only when the work is certified.
entries.trigger: Tutorial step 3 inside the work modal (UI:60); done when s.works.length>0.
entries.choiceEffects: The modal shows the cost, crews, service week and punctuality KPIs, the weekly payment sparkline and «+1,2 M€ al terminar» (UI:216-218). AIDS feder-norte 1,2 M€ (D:120) is paid in the close where the work reaches commissioning (R:1218, R:1261-1263).
entries.why: The aid timing is exact: it is paid at certification. Payments start at the close (R:322, R:1209), and the first week amount is in the quote (R:328). Minor gap: the other mandatory payments (2,5 M€ to suppliers in week 5) are only on the Finanzas page (UI:290), not in the work modal.
entries.unifiedFix: Keep. Add a «caja mínima prevista» row (cashProjection(s).min and its week, R:135-147) to every approval modal, so «lo que tienes que pagar pronto» is literally on screen.

entries.text: Fermín, del taller. Un tren nuevo tarda cuatro semanas en llegar. Y un tren en revisión no circula. Si la vía sigue rota, un tren más es un tren más llegando tarde.
entries.claim: A new train takes four weeks to arrive; a train in revision does not run; with the track broken, one more train is one more late train.
entries.trigger: Tutorial step 4 (UI:61), focus Flota.
entries.choiceEffects: KAFKA Civia: weeks 4 (D:76) → status «arriving», available at the close of W+3, shown as «Llega sem. W+4» (R:513, 523, 1173; UI:247, 507). Revision: corridor=null for 2 weeks, 1 with «contrato» (R:470-483). One more train on the Norte at week 1: +0,49 k pax and +0,009 M€/week revenue for +0,064 M€/week cost, with the punctuality target unchanged at 63,42 % (sim a1; R:199 rel=(punct/100)²).
entries.why: All three claims match the engine: KAFKA takes 4 weeks (Dörfler 6, BCBB 3, used 1), a revision removes the train, and an extra train on bad track loses money.
entries.unifiedFix: Keep. In Trenespop, the default new regional (Civia-type, 3 kV, Iberian) keeps a 4-week delivery and used ads keep 1 week, so the line stays true. The «Llega sem. N» label must come from the same field.

entries.text: Tienes tres órdenes por semana. Mirar, comparar y deshacer lo que no has confirmado es gratis. Cuando lo tengas, cierra la semana o avanza hasta la próxima decisión.
entries.claim: Three orders per week; looking, comparing and undoing unconfirmed plans is free; then close the week or advance to the next decision.
entries.trigger: Tutorial step 5 (UI:62).
entries.choiceEffects: ORDERS_PER_WEEK=3 (D:9), enforced in needOrder (R:284-288). Quotes are pure functions. advance() closes up to 13 weeks until stopReasons (R:1320-1345).
entries.why: Matches. Bribes (R:769), research (R:701), answering decisions (R:933), rejecting pacts (R:580) and the sliders do not cost orders, and nothing says they do.
entries.unifiedFix: Keep. Publish the list of order-costing actions in the help, and keep 3 pips.

entries.text: Eso es. La semana se ha cerrado: trenes, billetes, nóminas y obra. A partir de aquí decides tú. Yo vuelvo cuando haya foto.
entries.claim: The week was closed (trains, tickets, payroll, works); from now on you decide; the minister returns when there is a photo opportunity.
entries.trigger: Final tutorial step after s.week>1 (UI:62-63).
entries.choiceEffects: None.
entries.why: closeWeek runs operation, revenue, payroll and works (R:1164-1310). The minister comes back with ev-visita (weeks 7-199, R:898) and the inauguration pact (from week 40, D:320). Weak point: the closed week is only summarised as a toast «Semana N · ±X» (UI:433); the report is not shown.
entries.unifiedFix: Keep, and show the weekly report the line refers to (see other:weekly-report).

entries.text: Primer trimestre. Recupera el Norte: del sesenta y dos al ochenta por ciento de puntualidad en trece semanas. Y paga todo. Un impago en tu primer trimestre es un titular que no quiero leer.
entries.claim: First quarter: take the Norte from 62 % to 80 % punctuality in 13 weeks and pay everything; a default in the first quarter is unacceptable.
entries.trigger: Stage-intro pushed at new game (UI:536, UI:561); the line is spoken, the goal text is hidden (UI:386).
entries.choiceEffects: At the close of week 13: ok = Norte punct ≥ 80 && !flags.defaulted (R:1063-1064, R:1112-1117). defaulted is set when a payment exceeds cash during stage 0 (R:1253). Pass gives +8 ★; fail gives a grave breach plus economía −5 and viajeros −3 (R:1119-1120).
entries.why: Numbers and conditions match: Norte starts at 62 (D:27), the target is 80, and the deadline is week 13 (D:253). A default sets the flag. The value is checked at the instant of week 13, which the line allows.
entries.unifiedFix: Keep. With segments, Norte punctuality comes from the segment model.

entries.text: Ahora los tres esenciales: Norte, Levante y Sur fiables antes de fin de año. Y no bajes de tres millones en caja. No es una sugerencia, es mi tensión arterial.
entries.claim: Norte, Levante and Sur reliable before the end of the year, and never go below 3 M€ in cash.
entries.trigger: Stage-intro pushed by evaluateStage at the close of week 13 (R:1122-1126).
entries.choiceEffects: At the close of week 52 only (R:1114): rows Norte, Levante and Sur ≥ 80 and cash ≥ 3 (R:1065-1066).
entries.why: «No bajes de tres millones» implies a continuous floor. The engine checks the cash only once, at the close of week 52, so the player can sit at 0,5 M€ for months.
entries.unifiedFix: Track the minimum cash at every close of weeks 14-52 (s.stageMin.cash). The stage fails if it ever drops below 3 M€, and the mission row shows «mínimo X M€ (sem. N)». Text not recorded; it can stay.

entries.text: Querido presidente de Tenfe: sanea las cuentas, cumple el programa y gánanos las elecciones. En ese orden o en cualquier otro, pero las tres.
entries.claim: Clean up the accounts, fulfil the programme and win the elections; all three are required.
entries.trigger: Stage-intro at the close of week 52 (R:1125).
entries.choiceEffects: At week 208 evaluateStage uses ok = rows[0].ok only, the 26-week ordinary result ≥ 0 (R:1116, R:1067). The «Encuestas» and «Programa ≥3/6» rows are shown but not required (R:1068-1069). The election is a separate game-over check (R:1128-1133). The programme only matters for the final verdict (R:1142).
entries.why: Only one of the three named conditions decides the stage. The mission panel even shows the other two as goal rows (UI:152).
entries.unifiedFix: Evaluate s3 after the week-208 election: pass = ordinary(26) ≥ 0 AND p-norte, p-esenciales and p-cuentas done AND election won. A lost election still ends the game. Alternatively drop the two decorative rows.

entries.text: Nuevo ministro, nuevas prioridades. Quiero tren en dos territorios olvidados y que Lowgo no se coma tus corredores buenos. Lo quiero en hilo y con fotos.
entries.claim: New minister: trains in two forgotten territories, and Lowgo must not eat your good corridors.
entries.trigger: Stage-intro at the close of week 208 (R:1125); Lowgo appears the same close (R:1278-1279).
entries.choiceEffects: At week 312: territories open with trains ≥ 2 (R:1070); share vs Lowgo = 1 − avg(rivalShare over levante, sur, mediterraneo), where a closed corridor counts as 1, i.e. fully lost (R:1071).
entries.why: The territories row matches. The Lowgo row requires the Mediterráneo, which «todavía no es tuyo» (D:37): with it closed, the share is 1 − (l + s + 1)/3, so it passes only if Levante + Sur ≤ 0,2 (sim a5: 67 % with both at 0). The «60 % de los viajeros» in the goal (D:266) is an unweighted average of shares, not passengers. «Nuevo ministro» is true (successor speaks), but Raquel keeps speaking pact-done, stage-pass, fin-retirada and end-win after week 209 (UI:439; R:646, R:1119).
entries.unifiedFix: Lowgo competes only on corridors the player operates and where Lowgo has paths (LAV/standard-gauge parallels). The share is pax-weighted: Σ my pax / Σ (my pax + Lowgo pax). The minister role switches by date for every generic line.

entries.text: Última legislatura. Cinco corredores fiables, nada de rescates y otras elecciones. Si lo consigues, te ponemos una placa. Pequeña.
entries.claim: Last term: five reliable corridors, no rescues, another election; a small plaque if you succeed.
entries.trigger: Stage-intro at the close of week 312 (R:1125).
entries.choiceEffects: At week 416: 5 corridors with a 12-week average ≥ 85 and no rescues from week 313 (R:1072-1073, R:1116). The election is separate (R:1289). No plaque exists. Milestone m5 lists «Placa conmemorativa en Atocha» (D:133), but nothing implements it.
entries.why: The conditions match. The plaque reward is promised and never given.
entries.unifiedFix: On s5 pass (or the final win), place a cosmetic plaque object at Madrid-Atocha on the map and record it in the verdict screen.

entries.text: No has cumplido el objetivo en plazo. Queda anotado en tu expediente como incumplimiento grave. Al tercero, el Ministerio os retira la concesión.
entries.claim: Missed objective = grave breach in your record; at the third the Ministry withdraws the concession.
entries.trigger: evaluateStage when the stage is not ok (R:1120).
entries.choiceEffects: breaches.grave++, economía −5, viajeros −3, end at 3 (R:1120-1121). Three minor OSP breaches also add a grave one (R:1250).
entries.why: Exact. The −5/−3 support hit is not mentioned, but nothing contradicts it.
entries.unifiedFix: Keep.

entries.text: Objetivo cumplido. Lo voy a contar como si hubiera sido idea mía, que para eso estoy.
entries.claim: Objective met; the minister will take the credit.
entries.trigger: Used twice: (1) stage pass at the stage deadline, +8 ★ (R:1119); (2) the «Causa archivada» notice when 10 calm weeks with evidence < 8 archive the case (R:875).
entries.choiceEffects: None (notice).
entries.why: Use (2) has the minister say «Objetivo cumplido… idea mía» when a court case against the player is archived. Use (1) at weeks 312 and 416 is voiced by Raquel, although stage-s4 announced a new minister (Óscar) from week 209.
entries.unifiedFix: Stage pass: speaker = minister of the date (Raquel ≤ 208, Óscar ≥ 209), with one recording each. Archived case: new line «jud-archivo» (Charo: «Archivada por falta de pruebas. No lo celebres en público.»).

entries.text: Ministro, mi pueblo necesita una estación. Viajeros tenemos pocos; votantes, los suficientes para que me escuche.
entries.claim: The mayor asks for a station; few passengers but enough voters.
entries.trigger: Pact offer in week 3 if pactLog is empty (R:683); played in showOffer (UI:403).
entries.choiceEffects: Accept: +10 territorios (permanent), +4 ★ (D:294; R:595-610). The task is a 1,4 M€ station with one crew for 5 weeks: buildStation pushes a Norte work with phases [1,3,1], mode «fases», 1 crew (R:612-620). When done: Norte pot ×1,03, punct −1, territorios target +4 (R:195, 184, 1016). Hidden: it takes the Norte work slot, so «Ya hay una obra en marcha» blocks the renovation for 5 weeks (R:301; sim a4), and it removes 9 points of punctuality during the 3 build weeks (R:180; sim a4: target 54,77 vs 63,86). Reject: territorios −2 (R:580). Broken: −14 territorios, grudge mayor ×2 (R:627, 637) → «Rencor de Paco» −5 (R:1016) and the Paco extortion (R:851). Cheaper: 0,9 M€, +6 territorios, 2 ★ (D:295).
entries.why: The vote claim holds (+10 territorios). But Paco addresses the player as «Ministro», while the player is president of Tenfe (stage-s3: «Querido presidente de Tenfe»). The obligation hides two s1-critical costs: the blocked Norte work slot and −9 punctuality.
entries.unifiedFix: Recorded line. The station becomes a node work at Villanueva that does not occupy the corridor segment slot. If it must close track, the obligation states «bloquea obras en el Norte 5 semanas, −9 de puntualidad». Re-record «Ministro» → «Presidente» (~50 s), or make Paco consistently mistake the title in his later lines.

entries.text: La plantilla firma la paz si subes la nómina un seis por ciento. Medio año sin huelgas. Y sin recortes, que nos conocemos.
entries.claim: Peace if payroll rises 6 %: half a year without strikes and no cuts.
entries.trigger: Random pact offer from week 8: 9 %/week, then a pick among eligible pacts (R:684-688; earliest 8, D:296).
entries.choiceEffects: Accept: +10 trabajadores. Payroll ×1,06 on staff, own crews and onboard crews (R:258-261). The huelga event is suppressed (R:893), fewer trains are blocked (R:430) and firing is blocked (R:498). Broken when flags.cut > start, which only the insolvency «sell»/«cut» choices set (R:977, 980; R:666): −15 trabajadores and strike = week+2 (R:628). At the deadline it is fulfilled (R:675, +3 ★). Cheaper: 3 %, +5 (D:301).
entries.why: 6 % and 26 weeks are exact. The stated consequence «huelga de dos semanas» gives one: breakPact runs in step 6 of the close, after operation (R:1269), so strike = week+2 covers a single operated week (sim a3: closes 15 active, 16 not). A cut in the signing week is not detected (strict «>», R:666; sim a8). The cheaper card still shows «+10» while it gives +5 (sim a8, UI:320).
entries.unifiedFix: Strike as an interval {from: next operated week, weeks: N} with tickets ×0,4. Detect cuts with ≥. Cheaper pacts carry their own benefit text.

entries.text: Te ofrezco un contrato-programa: más subvención cada trimestre. A cambio, cuentas en positivo y ni un préstamo más. Si me fallas, me lo devuelves con intereses y con auditoría.
entries.claim: More subsidy each quarter for positive accounts and no new loans; if you fail, you repay with interest and get audited.
entries.trigger: Random pact offer from week 20 (D:302).
entries.choiceEffects: Accept: ospBonus +0,8 per quarter (R:602, 1247). Loans are blocked (R:546). Check ordinaryQuarters at the 39-week deadline: ≥ 2 of 3 quarters with positive ordinary (R:657, 664, 672-677). Fail: repay Σbonus at week+2 (2,4 M€ in sim a4), flags.audit = week+2 (R:631-632), economía −6. A loan taken in the same week before signing breaks it at the first close (sim a8).
entries.why: «Me lo devuelves con intereses»: the repayment is exactly the bonus received, with no interest (R:631). «Con auditoría»: flags.audit only makes the random «auditoria» event eligible (R:896, weight 2 inside a 20 %/week roll), so the audit may never happen.
entries.unifiedFix: Repayment = Σbonus × (1 + 4,5 % × years), or a flat +10 %. A breach schedules a certain Treasury audit 2 weeks later that inspects the secrets ledger (see ev-auditoria).

entries.text: Te presto una cuadrilla de Adif tres meses. Gratis. Bueno, gratis no: luego me pagas unos gastos de coordinación. Así funciona esto.
entries.claim: Adif lends a crew for three months, «free» but you pay coordination costs afterwards.
entries.trigger: Random pact offer from week 6 (D:308).
entries.choiceEffects: Accept: crews.loan for 12 weeks, with no payroll because the personal row excludes loan crews (R:601, 261). At the deadline it auto-pays 0,6 M€ if cash ≥ 0,6, otherwise it breaks: slowPermits 52 weeks, prep ×1,5 (R:673-674, 629, 311). Cheaper: 0,35 M€.
entries.why: Three months ≈ 12 weeks, free payroll and a fee at the end all match. Side issue: when the crew leaves, works it was on keep going (no crew check at close, R:1207-1222).
entries.unifiedFix: Keep. In the unified engine, crews are bound to works, and a work loses progress (pauses) when its crew leaves.

entries.text: Firma una carta de compromisos: Norte, Levante y Sur al ochenta y cinco por ciento. Si cumples, te aplaudimos. Si no, te reclamamos hasta el último billete.
entries.claim: Commit Norte, Levante and Sur to 85 %; applause if met, claims «to the last ticket» if not.
entries.trigger: Random pact offer from week 10 (D:314).
entries.choiceEffects: Accept: +12 viajeros. check essentials85 every week, fulfilled as soon as true (R:651, 671; +3 ★). After 20 weeks: −16 viajeros and a 0,5 M€ indemnity at week+1 (R:626). Cheaper: 80 %, +7.
entries.why: Exact for the full version. The cheaper card shows +12 while it gives +7 (see PACTS:carta-viajeros).
entries.unifiedFix: Keep; fix the cheaper-terms display.

entries.text: Necesito cortar una cinta antes de las elecciones. Me da igual qué. Una obra, un andén, un banco del parque. Tú termina algo y yo pongo la sonrisa.
entries.claim: The minister needs to cut a ribbon before the elections: finish anything (a work, a platform, a bench) and she smiles.
entries.trigger: Random pact offer from week 40. Minister pacts are excluded after week 208 (R:686).
entries.choiceEffects: Accept: +6 ★. finishAny = s.finished > finishedAtStart (R:653). Any work counts, including the Paco station and megaproject stages (R:1218, 1230). Reward 1 M€ + 3 ★. Fail: ospCut 1 M€ on the next quarter (R:630, 1247) and grudge «minister» (R:627).
entries.why: «Una obra, un andén» holds: the station counts. «Antes de las elecciones»: an offer after week 194 has a deadline past week 208. «Una ministra muy enfadada» (D:323): the minister grudge is never read anywhere (only «mayor» is read, R:851, 1016).
entries.unifiedFix: Deadline = min(start+14, 207). The minister grudge has an effect: −0,5 M€ on the next OSP and no ev-visita or inauguration offers for 26 weeks.

entries.text: España no se acaba en la Castellana. Tres millones si pones un tren diario en algún sitio que nadie sepa señalar en el mapa.
entries.claim: Three million if you put a daily train somewhere nobody can find on a map.
entries.trigger: Random pact offer from week 160 (D:326).
entries.choiceEffects: Accept: +8 territorios. territoryOpen = any territory corridor open with trains > 0 (R:656), checked every week (R:671). Reward 3 M€. Cheaper: 2,2 M€ in 40 weeks.
entries.why: If a territory is already served when signing, the pact pays 3 M€ at the next close for nothing (sim a4: done in its first week, +2,56 M€ including operations). «Tren diario» = trains > 0; the weekly model has no frequency.
entries.unifiedFix: Store a baseline at signing: the condition is a territory opened after the start, or the number of served territories increased. «Diario» = at least one round trip per day in the corridor timetable (the classic schedule data).

entries.text: Tengo un plan de comunicación: tres inauguraciones en seis meses. Tú pones las obras, yo pongo los tuits. Si no hay obras, también habrá tuits. Sobre ti.
entries.claim: Three inaugurations in six months; if not, tweets about you.
entries.trigger: Random pact offer from week 220, successor only from week 209 (R:686).
entries.choiceEffects: Accept: +6 ★, +6 viajeros. finish3 within 26 weeks (R:654). Fail: −10 viajeros. Cheaper: 2 works, +4/+4.
entries.why: 26 weeks ≈ 6 months and 3 finishes match.
entries.unifiedFix: Keep; fix the cheaper display.

entries.text: Te propongo un trato entre caballeros. Mis autocares te llevan gente a Soria y a Teruel. Tú te olvidas de Extremadura un año. Nadie tiene por qué enterarse.
entries.claim: Gentlemen's deal: his coaches feed Soria and Teruel; you forget Extremadura for a year; nobody needs to know.
entries.trigger: Random pact offer from week 100 (D:338).
entries.choiceEffects: Accept: pot ×1,12 for Soria and Teruel (R:196). Opening Extremadura is warned (R:453), but the UI forces it (force=true, UI:510) → breakPact (R:466) → leak = exposeSecret(first unexposed secret || «pacto») (R:633). Fulfilled at 52 weeks (R:675). Cheaper: 30 weeks.
entries.why: The feeder effect and «un año» hold. «Nadie tiene por qué enterarse»: the pact's corrupt:true (D:341) is never read, so signing adds no secret or suspicion. On a breach Íñigo leaks another secret if one exists, not the pact. The «pacto» scandal reuses sc-sobres («alcaldes, inspectores y diputados…», R:797).
entries.unifiedFix: Signing adds secret «pacto-meseta» (witness Íñigo, suspicion +4). A breach exposes that secret with its own line («Caso Autocares»). The feeder applies only while Soria or Teruel are open.

entries.text: Ya tenemos apeadero. Doscientos vecinos, un andén y una banda de música que solo se sabe dos canciones. Ministro, esto no se olvida en las urnas.
entries.claim: The station is built; the village will remember it at the polls.
entries.trigger: Close where the station work is commissioned (R:1272). Notice text: «El Norte tiene parada nueva: algo más de demanda y un alcalde feliz.»
entries.choiceEffects: stationNorte: pot ×1,03, punct −1 (R:195, 184); territorios target «Apeadero de Villanueva» +4 (R:1016); the pact is fulfilled the next close, +3 ★ (R:669).
entries.why: The demand and vote effects match. Paco again says «Ministro» (see paco-estacion).
entries.unifiedFix: Keep; align the title with paco-estacion. Not recorded, so the text can change freely.

entries.text: Lo del sobre, ni una palabra. Usted me arregla la comarca y yo le arreglo los permisos. Aquí las cosas se hacen como toda la vida.
entries.claim: Silence about the envelope; Paco arranges the permits in exchange.
entries.trigger: After a successful «alcalde» bribe (UI:526).
entries.choiceEffects: fastPermits until week+8: prep ×0,5 rounded (R:311, 314). Renovar, apartaderos and apeadero prep stay at 1 week; señalización 2→1; electrificar 3→2 (sim a3). Also +6 territorios (temporary) and secret «sobres» (R:775).
entries.why: «Le arreglo los permisos» has no effect on the 1-week preps, which include the most common work (renovar). «Usted me arregla la comarca» creates no obligation and no tracked debt.
entries.unifiedFix: Permits in days: −50 % of prep with day resolution, so a 1-week prep becomes 3-4 days and works can finish mid-week. Register the envelope in the secrets ledger with Paco as witness; that is what ext-paco can later threaten to tell.

entries.text: Pacto cumplido. Fíjate, una promesa política cumplida. Lo enmarco.
entries.claim: Pact fulfilled: a kept political promise, to be framed.
entries.trigger: fulfilPact (R:639-647).
entries.choiceEffects: +3 ★, plus the cash reward if any (R:642-644).
entries.why: The mechanics are right, but the speaker is always Raquel (minister): after week 209 (Óscar's term), for pacts with other people (Paco, Fermín, Charo, Benito, Marisa), and even for the secret pact with Íñigo, which a minister should not «enmarcar».
entries.unifiedFix: Speaker = the counterpart of the pact (one short line per counterpart), or the minister of the date. Corrupt pacts have no public celebration.

entries.text: Has incumplido un pacto firmado. La gente tiene memoria y yo tengo hojas de cálculo.
entries.claim: You broke a signed pact; people and Treasury remember.
entries.trigger: breakPact (R:621-638). The notice text = why + the pact consequence (R:636).
entries.choiceEffects: Pact penalties: groups, indemnity, grudge, strike, slowPermits, ospCut, repayment, audit, leak (R:625-634).
entries.why: Generic narrator line; the penalties listed in the text are applied (with the caveats noted per pact).
entries.unifiedFix: Keep.

entries.text: Han aceptado la versión barata. No te acostumbres.
entries.trigger: respondPact «negotiate» succeeds; chance = cheaper.chance + (group − 45)/200 (R:586-587). Shown in a modal (UI:413-415).
entries.choiceEffects: The cheaper terms are signed (R:595-605).
entries.why: True, but the player never sees the cheaper benefit. The active-pact card shows the original benefit for 5 pacts (paco, convenio, carta, cohesion, tuits; sim a8). Charo narrates negotiations she is not part of.
entries.unifiedFix: Show the cheaper terms in this modal. The counterpart speaks the acceptance.

entries.text: No hay rebaja. O lo tomas o lo dejas. Y te aviso: dejarlo también tiene precio.
entries.claim: «No rebate, take it or leave it; and leaving it also has a price.»
entries.trigger: respondPact «negotiate» fails (R:589); modal UI:413-415.
entries.choiceEffects: The offer stays with negotiated=true; the order is already spent (R:583). Rejecting afterwards costs only territorios −2, and only for Paco (R:580).
entries.why: Always spoken by Íñigo (rival, D:401), even when negotiating with Fermín, Charo, Marisa or Benito. «Dejarlo también tiene precio» is false for 8 of the 9 pacts.
entries.unifiedFix: Per-counterpart refusal lines, or a neutral narrator. Implement a reject cost per counterpart: Fermín −3 trabajadores, Charo −0,2 M€ next OSP, Marisa −3 viajeros, Benito +1 week of permits for 8 weeks, Pedro/Raquel/Óscar −2 ★.

entries.text: Se nos ha muerto un tren en plena rampa. Puedo arreglarlo rápido pagando horas extra, o lo meto en el taller tres semanas. Tú decides cuánto lloramos.
entries.claim: A train died on a ramp; fix it fast with overtime, or three weeks in the workshop.
entries.trigger: Forced at the close of week 2 (R:924), on the lowest-condition service train (La Abuela, Serie 592, 48 %, Norte; sim a2). Afterwards random: 20 %/week from week 5, weight 3, when any service train has a corridor (R:889, 925-929); about 4 per year in a passive run (sim a6).
entries.choiceEffects: «Horas extra (0,25 M€)»: train broken with weeks:1 → back at step 1 of the next close (R:941, 1174-1176), so it misses 0 operated weeks (sim a2). «Al taller tres semanas»: weeks:3 → misses 2 operated weeks (closes of weeks 3 and 4), back for week 5 (R:942; sim a2). Both return at condition ≥ 60 (R:1175).
entries.why: «Tres semanas» = 2 lost weeks; «vuelve la semana que viene» = no loss at all. The broken train is the worst one on the network, not one «en plena rampa». Separately, about 3,1 silent breakdowns per year (R:1203-1204; sim a6) never reach the player (report not shown).
entries.unifiedFix: One breakdown system: p = f(reliability, condition, segment stress: ramp, heat). Every breakdown has a train and a segment. The week-2 tutorial breakdown is La Abuela (Serie 592, diesel, 49 %) on mad–avi, the Guadarrama ramp, so «en plena rampa» is literal. Choices: overtime = 1 lost operated week; workshop = 3 lost operated weeks, counted in operated weeks.

entries.text: Nos han robado cuatro kilómetros de cable de cobre. Otra vez. El Sur va a ir con retrasos hasta que lo repongamos.
entries.claim: Four kilometres of copper cable stolen again; the Sur will run late until it is replaced.
entries.trigger: Random, weight 1, when Sur is open && elec (R:890).
entries.choiceEffects: «Reponer (0,3 M€)»: nothing else (R:943). «Esperar al seguro»: incidentWeeks=2 → target −10 for 2 closes (R:944, 1191-1192). Realised Sur punctuality: 67,13 / 65,63 / 68,48 / 70,21 vs 70,93 / 70,88 / 70,83 / 70,78 without the theft (sim a3): a maximum loss of 5,2 points.
entries.why: The note «El Sur pierde 10 puntos de puntualidad dos semanas» (R:905) is the target change; the visible loss is about half and lasts about 4 weeks. Restricting it to an electrified Sur is right (the real Sur conventional line is 3 kV throughout).
entries.unifiedFix: Theft on a named 3 kV segment of the Sur (e.g. alc–lin, 167 km): a temporary speed limit (vmax 30-60 km/h) for 2 weeks if you wait, none if you pay. The note shows the realised loss computed with punctProjection.

entries.text: Cuarenta y cuatro grados y el aire acondicionado del tren en huelga. Hay gente abanicándose con el billete.
entries.claim: 44 °C and the train's air conditioning is broken.
entries.trigger: Random, weight 2, for week-of-year 26-35, i.e. 28 June to 30 August (R:891).
entries.choiceEffects: «Reparar (0,2 M€)»: +2 viajeros. «Abanicos»: −4 viajeros (R:945-946). Both are temporary nudges that decay toward the target at 7 %/week (R:1042).
entries.why: The season is right. There is no train, no corridor and no A/C state: the event is a flat support tax.
entries.unifiedFix: A/C reliability per train (older units such as Serie 592 are worse) on hot corridors (Sur, Extremadura, Levante, Ebro). The event names the train and corridor. Repair = that train out for 1 week; waiting = that corridor's demand ×0,9 for 2 weeks plus the viajeros hit.

entries.text: Ha nevado en Pajares y en la meseta. Puedo sacar la quitanieves si pagas, o esperamos a que salga el sol.
entries.claim: Snow on Pajares and the meseta; pay for the snowplough or wait for the sun.
entries.trigger: Random, weight 2, for week-of-year 1-8 (4 Jan-22 Feb) or 49-52 (6-27 Dec) (R:892).
entries.choiceEffects: «Quitanieves (0,15 M€)»: Norte incidentNow 3 → −1,1 points (R:947). «Esperar»: Norte 15, and Asturias 15 if open (R:948). Realised Norte: 57,49 vs 63,19 without snow (−5,7), still −2,2 three weeks later (sim a3).
entries.why: «El Norte pierde 15 puntos esta semana» (R:907) is the target change; the realised loss is −5,7 and it lingers for weeks. Pajares belongs to Asturias (León–Pola de Lena), which is often closed when the event mentions it.
entries.unifiedFix: Snow hits mountain segments in winter weeks: mad–avi Guadarrama, leo–pol Pajares if open, trb–sor, zar–ter. Waiting = those segments closed (or vmax 40) for 1 week; plough = cost per segment. The text names only segments that are in service.

entries.text: La plantilla va a la huelga. Dicen que trabajan por tres y cobran por uno. Yo no digo nada, pero tienen razón.
entries.claim: The workforce goes on strike: they work for three and are paid for one.
entries.trigger: Random, weight 3, when trabajadores < 38 && no convenio && no strike running (R:893).
entries.choiceEffects: «Negociar: +2 % de nómina»: flags.payrollExtra += 0,02 and +6 trabajadores (R:949). It is never charged: weeklyAccounts only applies pact upkeep (R:258); costs 0,79706 → 0,79706 (sim a3). Instead it adds a permanent +3 support row «Mejoras de nómina» (R:1017). «Aguantar»: strike = week+2 → 2 operated weeks at 40 % tickets and pax (R:1194; sim a3 tickets 0,17 vs 0,43), −4 trabajadores −4 viajeros. «Sobre al delegado (0,2 M€)»: suspicion +8, evidence +8, secret «sobres» (R:951).
entries.why: The «+2 % de nómina» deal costs nothing and gives permanent support. «Aguantar» is exact.
entries.unifiedFix: Payroll multiplier = 1 + pact upkeep + payrollExtra in weeklyAccounts (staff, crews, onboard crews). Trigger from causes: crew workload (busy/total > 0,9 for 8 weeks) or payroll frozen for 52 weeks, not only the support threshold.

entries.text: Un vídeo de una revisora cantando jotas en el Teruel tiene dos millones de visitas. Por una vez, hablan bien de nosotros.
entries.claim: A video of a ticket inspector singing jotas «en el Teruel» goes viral.
entries.trigger: Random, weight 1, from week 9 (R:894), with no check on Teruel.
entries.choiceEffects: «Contratarla»: +5 viajeros, +3 ★ (R:952).
entries.why: In 12 passive 8-year games, all 120 viral events fired while the Teruel line had no service (sim a6). There is no inspector on a line that does not run.
entries.unifiedFix: Eligible only if Teruel is open with ≥ 1 train (and staff on board). Otherwise use a generic variant naming an open corridor (new recording) or drop it.

entries.text: Desprendimiento de rocas en la trinchera. Nadie herido, pero la vía está cortada. Lo despejo en una semana si me das una cuadrilla.
entries.claim: Rockfall in the cutting: the line is cut; one crew clears it in a week.
entries.trigger: Random, weight 1, from week 11 (R:895).
entries.choiceEffects: «Mandar una cuadrilla (0,1 M€)»: slideCrew=1, one more busy crew until the next close (R:115, 953, 1185). No corridor is cut. It works even with 0 free crews (free goes to −1, sim a8). «Esperar a Adif»: a random open corridor without works is closed for 3 weeks (R:954; 3 closes, coherent). If every open corridor has works, pick() returns undefined and .id throws (sim a5: «Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'id')»).
entries.why: «La vía está cortada» never happens with the crew option. The affected corridor is unknown when choosing and is drawn afterwards. A crew is conjured when none is free. A crash is possible.
entries.unifiedFix: Pick an open segment tagged «trinchera/talud» before showing the event, name it in the title, and close it immediately. Crew option: requires a free crew, reopens after 1 week. Wait: closed 3 weeks. No eligible segment → no event.

entries.text: Auditoría del Tribunal de Cuentas. Van a mirar cada factura. Si hay algo que no deba estar, es buen momento para preocuparse.
entries.claim: Court of Audit inspection: they will check every invoice.
entries.trigger: Random, weight 2, when evidence > 12 or flags.audit (R:896).
entries.choiceEffects: «Colaborar»: if evidence > 20 (note «Van a encontrar cosas»), suspicion +15 and economía −5; otherwise economía +3 (R:955). «Destructora» (tech): evidence −15, suspicion +10 (R:956).
entries.why: «Van a encontrar cosas» finds nothing concrete: no secret is exposed and no judicial step happens. The audit promised by the contrato-programa is only this random event.
entries.unifiedFix: The audit walks the secrets ledger: each unexposed secret whose evidence ≥ 10 is found → exposeSecret, and the judicial stage goes to ≥ 1. A contrato-programa breach schedules it for certain.

entries.text: Lowgo empieza a operar en tus corredores buenos. Billetes a nueve euros, asientos de plástico y una sonrisa. Que gane el mejor. O el más barato.
entries.claim: Lowgo starts operating in your good corridors with €9 tickets.
entries.trigger: Notice at the close of week 208 (R:1279). The rival is created the same close: levante, sur, mediterraneo, strength 0,2 → +0,0006/week, max 0,4 (R:1278, 1280).
entries.choiceEffects: rivalShare = strength/(mine + strength), capped at 0,7 (R:214-218), multiplies demand (R:203).
entries.why: No fare exists: «billetes a nueve euros» is not modelled (strength is abstract). It competes on the Mediterráneo even if the player never opened it. It is voiced by Íñigo, owner of Autocares Meseta (a coach company), not by Lowgo.
entries.unifiedFix: Lowgo is an operator with fare 9 €, seats and paths only on LAV/standard-gauge relations parallel to the corridors (Madrid–València, Madrid–Sevilla, València–Barcelona). Demand is split by fare and travel time. It has its own spokesperson, or a narrator.

entries.text: Bruselas nos ha dado una propina. No es mucho, pero cuéntalo como si fuera el plan Marshall.
entries.claim: Brussels gave us a tip; sell it like the Marshall Plan.
entries.trigger: Random, weight 1, from week 21 (R:897).
entries.choiceEffects: «Aceptar y anunciarlo»: +0,5 M€, +2 ★ (R:957).
entries.why: It does exactly what it says. It is an unearned random gift (≈1,2/year, sim a6).
entries.unifiedFix: Keep, but tie it to an application (a CEF/FEDER call) that the player submits for a specific segment work. The tip is paid when the call resolves.

entries.text: Vengo de visita al Norte con tres cámaras. Si el tren llega a su hora, sales en el telediario. Si no, también.
entries.claim: The minister visits the Norte with cameras; on time = TV glory, late = TV anyway.
entries.trigger: Random, weight 1, weeks 7-199 (R:898).
entries.choiceEffects: «Recibirla en Valladolid»: Norte ≥ 80 → +4 ★ +4 viajeros, else −4 viajeros (R:958). «Inventarse una avería»: grudge «minister» (R:959), note «Ministra mosqueada».
entries.why: The receive branch matches the line. «Ministra mosqueada» has no effect: the minister grudge is never read.
entries.unifiedFix: The visit rides a specific train on a Norte segment (outcome = that train's punctuality). The minister grudge has effects (see raquel-inauguracion).

entries.text: Los trenes nuevos de BCBB no caben en los túneles de Cantabria. Han medido el gálibo con un metro de costurera.
entries.claim: The new BCBB trains do not fit Cantabria's tunnels (loading gauge).
entries.trigger: Random, weight 4, when flags.bcbb (any BCBB ever bought, even undelivered, R:525) && Cantabria open && !flags.tuneles (R:899).
entries.choiceEffects: «Pedir perdón y recortar los trenes» (note «-5 de los territorios, el BCBB no circula en Cantabria»): territorios −5 and flags.tuneles=true (R:960). No train is moved. A BCBB can still be assigned to Cantabria afterwards (sim a5: trainsOnCantabria ["bcbb"]).
entries.why: The restriction it announces is never applied. It fires even if no BCBB ever went to Cantabria.
entries.unifiedFix: Loading gauge per segment: pal–san (217 km, single track, 3 kV, 120 km/h) has a reduced gálibo; the BCBB offer has a wide gálibo. Assignment validation refuses BCBB on that segment. The event fires when a BCBB is ordered or assigned for Cantabria. Choices: move it (−5 territorios) or start a tunnel-clearance work.

entries.text: El fabricante te ofrece una atención: un siete por ciento del contrato en una cuenta suiza. El contrato sube un poco, claro. Alguien lo tiene que pagar.
entries.claim: The maker offers a 7 % «attention» in a Swiss account; the contract goes up a bit.
entries.trigger: Never pushed or spoken: no reference in rescate.js or rescate-ui.js. The kickback is a silent checkbox in the work and buy modals (UI:220, 250).
entries.choiceEffects: Checkbox: price ×1,1 (R:510, 308). Caja B += 7 % × (1 + kickback mod) of the inflated price. Suspicion +6, evidence +5, secret «comision» (R:756-761).
entries.why: The numbers it states are the implemented ones (7 %; «sube un poco» = +10 %), but the line is unused.
entries.unifiedFix: Speak it when a Trenespop new-train order or works contract is above X M€: the maker's rep offers the 7 % for that contract, and the choice replaces the silent checkbox. Speaker: the maker rep (KAFKA, Dörfler, BCBB, Malstom…), not Íñigo.

entries.text: Te propongo una cosa. Certificamos dos kilómetros de traviesas que ya estaban puestas. Nadie las va a contar. La diferencia, a medias.
entries.claim: Certify two km of sleepers already in place; split the difference.
entries.trigger: Set by the first renovar started after week 4 (R:352); offered while that work is in its build phase (R:820-825).
entries.choiceEffects: «Certificar»: caja B +0,5 × (1 + kickback mod), suspicion +8, evidence +10, secret «traviesas» (R:962). «Decirle que no» (note «Benito se lo toma mal»): fx «none», nothing happens.
entries.why: The fraud costs Tenfe nothing: the work cost and the aid are unchanged, so the money appears from nowhere. The refusal consequence is not implemented.
entries.unifiedFix: Certifying 2 phantom km adds 2 × perKm × price to the work cost (paid from caja A), and half goes to caja B. Refusing gives Benito a grudge with an effect: +1 week of permits on the next work.

entries.text: Este fin de semana salgo en el yate con los de BCBB. Gambas, champán y una propuesta de contrato. Vente, que el mar no graba.
entries.claim: Weekend on the yacht with BCBB: seafood, champagne and a contract proposal; the sea does not record.
entries.trigger: 2 weeks after buying a BCBB with the kickback (R:760, 826-831).
entries.choiceEffects: «Subir al yate»: caja B +0,3, +3 ★, suspicion +6, evidence +6, secret «yate» (R:963). «Quedarte en tierra»: nothing.
entries.why: It matches the note. «Una propuesta de contrato» does not produce one (flavor).
entries.unifiedFix: Keep. Íñigo appears as the go-between of the BCBB deal (store him as witness of the «yate» secret). Optionally the yacht unlocks a BCBB discount offer in Trenespop.

entries.text: Mi sobrino Borja necesita trabajo. Es muy espabilado: sabe de todo un poco. Hazle jefe de cuadrilla y te debo una.
entries.claim: The minister's nephew Borja wants to be a crew chief; she will owe you one.
entries.choiceEffects: «Contratar a Borja» (note «+0,6 M€ el próximo trimestre. Tus obras irán algo más lentas»): ospNext +0,6, secret «enchufe», suspicion +4, flags.borja (R:964). From then on every finished work removes 3 track points on its corridor (R:1317), including señalización and electrificación (sim a8: Levante 64,46 → 61,4 at the end of a signalling work). Phases are unchanged ([2,6,2] in both cases, sim a8). «No hay plaza»: −4 viajeros and grudge «minister» (no effect).
entries.why: «Tus obras irán algo más lentas» is false: they are not slower, they leave worse track. The refusal grudge does nothing.
entries.unifiedFix: Borja leads one crew. Works with that crew build ×1,33 slower. Firing him needs an order and gives the minister a grudge. The refusal costs −0,3 M€ on the next OSP.

entries.text: La cena de Navidad de la dirección: noventa mil euros en marisco. ¿Lo cargamos a «formación en seguridad»?
entries.claim: Management Christmas dinner: 90 k€ of seafood charged to «formación en seguridad»?
entries.trigger: Week-of-year 50 (13 December), 60 % chance, once a year (R:838-843).
entries.choiceEffects: «Cargarla»: −0,09 M€, +6 trabajadores, secret «mariscada», suspicion +3, evidence +4 (R:966). «Bar de la estación»: −0,01 M€, −2 trabajadores (R:967).
entries.why: The amounts match (90 k€). Odd but harmless: a management dinner pleases the workforce.
entries.unifiedFix: Keep; maybe make it a staff dinner in the text (it is not recorded).

entries.text: Tengo unas fotos tuyas muy bonitas. Cuatrocientos mil euros y se quedan en mi cajón. Si no, en la portada del domingo.
entries.claim: Íñigo has nice photos of you: 400 k€ or the Sunday front page.
entries.trigger: extortion(): needs an unexposed secret, week ≥ nextExtortion, and suspicion > 18 && !extInigo, then 25 % (R:846-861).
entries.choiceEffects: «Pagar 400 k€»: from caja B, or from caja A with +4 evidence (R:968). «No pagar»: exposeSecret(secret) immediately (R:969). «Abogados» (tech): 50/50 (R:970).
entries.why: The price is exact. «Fotos» exist only for the yacht. The secret threatened is the first unexposed one of any type (sim a5: «mariscada»).

entries.text: O mi estación sale adelante o le cuento a la prensa lo del sobre. Yo no tengo nada que perder. Tengo un pueblo de doscientos habitantes.
entries.claim: «Either my station goes ahead or I tell the press about the envelope.»
entries.trigger: extortion() with grudge «mayor» (only from a broken Paco pact, R:627, 637) and any unexposed secret (R:851).
entries.choiceEffects: «Pagar 250 k€»: silence. The station is NOT built or reopened. «No pagar»: exposes whatever secret is first (sim a5: «comision», with no envelope ever given to Paco).
entries.why: «Lo del sobre» is false unless an alcalde bribe exists. «Mi estación sale adelante» is not an option.
entries.unifiedFix: Requires the «sobres-alcalde» secret (Paco as witness). Choices: reopen the station task (build it now), pay 0,25 M€, or refuse → that specific secret is exposed.

entries.text: Me han llamado del juzgado. Si me subes el sueldo, me acuerdo de muy pocas cosas. Si no, me acuerdo de todas.
entries.claim: The court called Benito; raise his salary and he forgets.
entries.trigger: First unexposed secret === «traviesas» && judicial stage ≥ 1 && !extBenito (R:848, 851).
entries.choiceEffects: «Pagar 300 k€» once; «No pagar» → «traviesas» exposed.
entries.why: «Llamado del juzgado» holds (stage ≥ 1). «Me subes el sueldo» is a one-off payment, not a raise. Benito only asks if «traviesas» is first in the secrets array, which depends on order, not logic.
entries.unifiedFix: Make it a recurring cost (+0,3 M€/year to payroll while he stays). Select the secret by witness, not by array position.

entries.text: Ha salido el caso Traviesas: pagaste kilómetros de vía que no existen. La gente quiere saber dónde está el dinero. Yo también.
entries.claim: Caso Traviesas: you paid for kilometres of track that do not exist.

entries.choiceEffects: Hit 12 × (1 + scandal mod) × muffle: viajeros −hit, territorios −0,6 hit, trabajadores −0,5 hit, economía −0,8 hit; suspicion +15, evidence +10, −4 ★ (R:802-805). Choices: see decision:scandal-choices.
entries.why: The mechanics are coherent, but «pagaste» is not true in the engine: Tenfe never paid for the phantom km (see cor-traviesas).
entries.unifiedFix: Becomes literal once cor-traviesas inflates the work cost. The scandal names the corridor and the km from the ledger.

entries.choiceEffects: Hit 8.
entries.why: Consistent with Borja damaging works (−3 track per finished work).
entries.unifiedFix: Keep; with the cor-enchufe fix (slower works) still coherent.

entries.text: Caso Sobres: alcaldes, inspectores y diputados cobrando en mano. La Gaceta tiene una libreta con tus iniciales.
entries.claim: Caso Sobres: mayors, inspectors and MPs taking cash; a notebook with your initials.
entries.trigger: exposeSecret(«sobres») (any bribe R:775, strike bribe R:951), the «pacto» leak (R:797), the fallback for an unknown secret (R:800), and the accident notice «Descarrilamiento leve…» (R:867), which is followed by a second sc-sobres scandal modal (R:868; sim a8: two consecutive decisions with this line).
entries.choiceEffects: Hit 11 (sobres) or 9 (pacto).
entries.why: It always lists mayors, inspectors and MPs, whatever was actually bribed (it may only have been the union delegate). It is reused for the Autocares pact and for a derailment notice. The same secret can be hit again by the accident (exposeSecret does not skip exposed secrets, R:801-805).
entries.unifiedFix: Build the text from the ledger recipients. Separate lines for the accident (inspector) and for the Autocares pact. An exposed secret cannot be exposed again.

entries.text: Han pillado el soborno al juez. Esto ya no es un escándalo, es una película. Y tú sales en el cartel.
entries.claim: They caught the bribe to the judge; you star in the film.
entries.trigger: Juez bribe fails (30 %, R:784).

entries.why: The line itself is consistent. The silent stage jump and the bribe text «es el final» are separate problems (BRIBES:juez).
entries.unifiedFix: Keep. Route judicial stage changes through one function that emits jud-N and its hits.

entries.text: ¿Un sobre? ¿A mí? Acabo de reenviar tu oferta a la Fiscalía Anticorrupción con copia a mi madre.

entries.trigger: Tijera bribe fails (75 %, R:788).

entries.why: Prosecution → preliminary proceedings is consistent. The stage change is silent.

entries.claim: You are charged; every week passengers and MPs will look at you worse.

entries.why: The weekly erosion is implemented. «Diputados» maps to economía and the vote (flavor).

entries.choiceEffects: −10 to all groups.
entries.why: Matches (comic disowning).

entries.text: No llegas a los pagos. Elige ya: vender trenes, aplazar obras, renegociar la deuda o recortar servicios. Todo tiene un precio, y lo pagarás más tarde.
entries.claim: You cannot pay: sell trains, defer works, renegotiate debt or cut services; everything costs later.
entries.trigger: Cash < 0 after the close (R:1291-1294). The week cannot close until it is resolved (R:1166).
entries.choiceEffects: «Vender»: worst non-rented train at price × 0,55 × condition (R:977, 531); flags.cut (breaks convenio). «Aplazar»: first active work in phase < 2 is paused; resuming costs +10 % (R:978, 393-402). «Renegociar»: payments within 13 weeks move +13 weeks at ×1,08; economía −6 (R:979). «Recortar»: one train less on the worst-net corridor with > 1 trains; −4 viajeros −3 territorios; flags.cut (R:980). «Rescate (4 M€)»: 4 repayments of 1,1 M€ at +26/52/78/104 weeks; economía −8 (R:981).
entries.why: Choices can do nothing: «Aplazar» with no active work leaves cash unchanged (sim a8), and «Recortar» with no corridor above 1 train only applies the penalties. The decision is consumed anyway. The rescue note «no cuenta para ganar» is only enforced for rescues in the last 104 weeks (R:1144; sim a8: a week-100 rescue counts 0).
entries.unifiedFix: Disable no-op choices and show the cash each one recovers. Count rescues over the whole mandate, or say «en los dos últimos años».

entries.text: Cuatro semanas sin poder pagar. Tenfe entra en concurso de acreedores. Yo ya lo había dicho.
entries.claim: Four weeks unable to pay: bankruptcy.
entries.trigger: negativeWeeks ≥ 4 (R:1291-1293); end modal UI:439.
entries.choiceEffects: Game over.
entries.why: Matches.
entries.unifiedFix: Keep.

entries.text: Demasiados incumplimientos graves. El Ministerio os retira la concesión. Recoge tus cosas y deja la tarjeta de embarque.

entries.choiceEffects: Game over.
entries.why: The mechanics match, but it is voiced by Raquel even when it happens after week 209 (Óscar's term).

entries.text: Las encuestas están ahí. Mira qué grupos te sostienen y cuáles te van a dejar caer. Quedan pocos meses.

entries.trigger: Weeks 182 and 390, 26 weeks before each election (R:1287); the UI opens the Elections page after it (UI:399).

entries.unifiedFix: Keep.

entries.choiceEffects: +10 ★; the notice is shown only if week < 416.

entries.text: Ocho años, dos elecciones y una red que funciona sin rescates. Hay quien dice que es imposible. Tú lo has hecho.

entries.text: Título «Descarrilamiento leve en una obra recién certificada» · texto «Nadie herido, por suerte. El inspector dice que no se acuerda de nada. La Gaceta sí.»
entries.claim: A minor derailment on a work that was just certified without inspection.
entries.trigger: Each week, rand < risk/900; risk +8 per inspector bribe (D:352; R:779), never decays, reset to 0 only by the accident (R:866-868).
entries.choiceEffects: Notice with the sc-sobres line, then exposeSecret(«sobres») pushes a second modal «Caso Sobres de la Catenaria» with the same line (sim a8). The accident does not affect any corridor, train or work.
entries.why: With one bribe the chance is 0,89 %/week forever: the accident can come years later (sim a8: 195 weeks), when no work was «recién certificada». It plays the Caso Sobres line twice, and no derailment happens on the network.
entries.unifiedFix: Risk is attached to the works certified with the bribe and decays over 26 weeks. The accident happens on that work's segment: closure 1 week, a train damaged (−30 condition), a dedicated line. Then the inspector secret is exposed once.

entries.text: «Negarlo todo» (A veces cuela. A veces no.) · «Cesar a Benito Balasto» (Las pruebas bajan, la plantilla se enfada y Benito no olvida.) · «Comisión de investigación interna» (Menos daño ahora, más sospecha luego.) · «Comprar el silencio del periodista (0,3 M€ de caja B)» (Se acaba la noticia. Otra persona más lo sabe.)
entries.claim: Four ways to handle any scandal.
entries.trigger: Every exposeSecret (R:799-816).
entries.choiceEffects: Deny: 45 % → viajeros +4 economía +3, else −6/−4/−3/−5 and suspicion +8 (R:972). Scapegoat: evidence −15, trabajadores −6, grudge adif (never read), slowPermits ≥ week+26 (R:973). Commission: viajeros +3 economía +2, suspicion +6 (R:974). Buy (caja B ≥ 0,3): groups +5/+3/+2/+4, evidence +3 (R:975).
entries.why: «Cesar a Benito» is offered for scandals that have nothing to do with him (yacht, seafood, Charo, judge, nephew) and can be chosen repeatedly. Benito keeps speaking as Adif boss afterwards (ev-cable, ev-nevada, ev-desprendimiento, benito-cuadrilla). «Se acaba la noticia» does not undo the hit; it adds support afterwards.
entries.unifiedFix: Scapegoat only the secret's internal participant (Benito for traviesas/inspector, Fermín for the seafood dinner…). A dismissed person leaves the roster and a successor speaks Adif lines. «Comprar el silencio» before publication = cancel the hit; after publication = no option.

entries.why: The «ministra muy enfadada» grudge has no effect, and «de tu lado» is not a state.
entries.unifiedFix: Minister trust/grudge state with effects.

entries.text: Ganas «3 M€ de financiación prevista y +8 de los territorios» · Te obliga «Servicio diario en un territorio desatendido en 30 semanas» · Si fallas «se pierde la financiación y -10 de los territorios» · Rebajado «Servicio en un territorio en 40 semanas»

entries.why: Only the cheaper display is wrong.
entries.unifiedFix: Cheaper benefit text.

entries.text: Ganas «Autocares Meseta lleva viajeros a tus estaciones: +12 % de demanda en Soria y Teruel» · Te obliga «No abrir el corredor de Extremadura en 52 semanas» · Si fallas «Si lo abres: Íñigo filtra lo que sabe de ti» · Rebajado «No abrir Extremadura en 30 semanas»
entries.claim: Secret pact with the coach company.

entries.choiceEffects: See LINE inigo-noagresion.
entries.why: «Lo que sabe de ti» = the first unexposed secret, or «pacto» with the sobres line. corrupt:true is never read.

entries.text: Alcaldes de la comarca · 0,15 M€ · «Permisos municipales exprés: la preparación de las obras dura la mitad durante 8 semanas. +6 de los territorios.»
entries.claim: Halves the preparation of works for 8 weeks; +6 territorios.

entries.choiceEffects: Cost from caja B, or from caja A with evidence ×1,8 (R:772-774). Suspicion +7, evidence +6, secret «sobres». fastPermits = week+8, read when a work is quoted (R:311). +6 territorios (temporary).
entries.why: Math.round(1 × 0,5) = 1, so renovar, apartaderos and apeadero (1-week prep) gain nothing; señalización 2→1; electrificar 3→2 (sim a3).
entries.unifiedFix: Prep measured in days, or −50 % with day granularity.

entries.text: Inspector de Adif · 0,1 M€ · «Firma las pruebas sin mirar: las obras en pruebas terminan esta semana. Sube el riesgo de accidente.»
entries.claim: Works in testing finish this week; accident risk rises.

entries.unifiedFix: Per-work risk that decays; the accident happens on that segment.

entries.text: Redactor de La Gaceta del Raíl · 0,2 M€ · «El próximo escándalo sale en la página 47, entre los crucigramas: resta la mitad.»

entries.why: Exact.
entries.unifiedFix: Keep.

entries.unifiedFix: Keep.

entries.text: Delegado sindical · 0,2 M€ · «Desconvoca huelgas y calma a la plantilla: +8 de los trabajadores.»
entries.trigger: Cloacas page.
entries.choiceEffects: s.strike = 0 (ends the current strike only) and +8 trabajadores (R:782, 778).
entries.why: «Desconvoca huelgas» (plural) covers only the running one; a huelga event can fire the following week.
entries.unifiedFix: Also block the huelga event for 13 weeks.

entries.text: App que funciona · «Venta online: -15 % de costes comerciales y +5 % de demanda.»

entries.text: Trenes bimodo · «Las líneas sin catenaria gastan un 30 % menos de energía y fallan menos.»
entries.trigger: Research.
entries.choiceEffects: Diesel energy factor 1,5 × 0,7 (R:223). Breakdowns unchanged (R:1203); the «Sin electrificar» −3 is unchanged (R:176).
entries.why: «Fallan menos» is not implemented.
entries.unifiedFix: In the unified game «bimodo» is a train type (Dörfler FLIRT-BMU, Serie 730): it runs electric under 3 kV/25 kV and diesel elsewhere. Remove it as a network tech.

entries.text: Gabinete de prensa · «Los escándalos y las averías restan un 30 % menos de apoyo.»

entries.text: Mantenimiento predictivo · «Un 40 % menos de averías de trenes.»

entries.text: Electrificación · «Catenaria nueva: energía más barata, trenes más fiables y adiós al gasóleo.»
entries.claim: Cheaper energy, more reliable trains, no more diesel.
entries.trigger: startWork «electrificar».
entries.choiceEffects: c.elec = true (R:1316): energy ×1 instead of ×1,5 and the −3 punctuality cause removed (R:176, 223). The same trains keep running: a diesel Serie 592 on an electrified corridor pays electric energy (R:223).
entries.why: Reliability is unchanged, and «adiós al gasóleo» happens without changing the fleet.
entries.unifiedFix: Electrify a segment to 3 kV or 25 kV (the user's realism request). Energy cost by each train's traction. EMUs (Civia 3 kV, Serie 449, 480 bitensión) become assignable. Diesel units keep paying diesel.

entries.text: Centro de Control, etapa 3 «Integración de corredores» · 2,2 M€, 8 sem, 2 cuadrillas · «Las incidencias se resuelven antes: -30 % de su efecto.»
entries.trigger: startMegaStage.
entries.choiceEffects: mods.incident is never read (grep: no mod(s,«incident»)).
entries.why: 2,2 M€ and 2 crews for nothing.
entries.unifiedFix: c.incident × (1 + mod(s,«incident»)) in R:1191, and in speed-restriction durations.

entries.text: Ofertas: «Civia Regional 463» (KAFKA), «Dörfler LIRIO 4», «BCBB Fuxing Regional», «Serie 592 de segunda mano»
entries.claim: Implicitly, any train can run anywhere.
entries.trigger: reorganize/openCorridor assign any idle train.
entries.choiceEffects: No gauge, voltage or traction check. Sim a7: a KAFKA (real Civia 463 = 3 kV EMU, Iberian, 120 km/h, trains.json) was assigned to Extremadura (diesel) and Galicia (25 kV). BCBB «Fuxing» (real CR400AF: standard gauge, 25 kV) runs on Iberian 3 kV lines.
entries.why: This contradicts the user's realism requirement, and it is what makes ev-tuneles toothless.
entries.unifiedFix: Train profile from trains.json: traction, voltages[], gauge (ib/std/variable), vmax, seats, gálibo. assign() validates every segment of the corridor (rules.md traverse()). Trenespop shows compatibility per corridor.

entries.text: Ficha del corredor «345 km · electrificado» (UI:173) and the Catenaria/Ancho/Velocidad layers
entries.claim: Corridor length and per-segment gauge, voltage and speed.
entries.trigger: Corridor sheet and map layers.
entries.choiceEffects: km feed costs: canon 0,00011/km, track 0,00009/km, renovar 0,0068/km (R:13; D:95). Real km (segments.json): Norte 421 (game 345), Levante 487 (390), Sur 571 (470). baseSegments routes through the LAV: Norte pal–leo std/25 kV/280, Sur cor–sev std/25 kV/240, Asturias leo–pol mixto/25 kV/220 (sim a7). In reality all three are Iberian 3 kV conventional.
entries.why: The layers display gauges and voltages that the conventional corridors do not have.
entries.unifiedFix: Use segments.json as the corridor definition (CORRIDOR.segments, already supported by R:78).

entries.text: Extremadura «elec: false» · ayuda «Mecanismo Conectar Europa» 2,5 M€ «se cobran al electrificar Extremadura»
entries.trigger: Data.
entries.choiceEffects: A corridor-wide boolean.
entries.why: Real: Plasencia–Cáceres–Mérida–Badajoz is 25 kV (209 km) and Madrid–Talavera–Plasencia is diesel (268 km) (segments.json). «Electrificar Extremadura» is really «electrificar Madrid–Plasencia».
entries.unifiedFix: Per-segment elec; the CEF aid is tied to the mad–tal and tal–pla segments; 25 kV to match the existing southern section.
